description: Kitchen sink sprayer cracked on arrival. The water pump was also identified as needing replacement by Day 5.
response: The faucet head was replaced entirely. A pump workaround was kept in place for the duration of the mission.
lesson: Identify the water pump model from the previous crew's report and bring a replacement unit. Add the faucet assembly to the spare parts list — kitchen plumbing is vulnerable to freeze-thaw cycling.
